Product Features

  • 2-piece set: Two square coffee tables in different sizes for maximum flexibility.
  • High-gloss marble look: Both table tops are coated with an elegant, high-gloss marble look.
  • Height-adjustable feet: The desks have height-adjustable feet, ideal for uneven floors.
  • High load capacity: Both tables are stable and can carry up to 30 kg each.
  • Flexible design: The tables can be used together as a set or individually in different rooms.
  • Versatile: Perfect for living rooms or other living areas, suitable for any interior style.
  • Modern design: Timeless and elegant design that blends seamlessly into any interior.
  • The coffee table top is made of a high-gloss marble pattern rather than a marble stone top.

Descriptions

This elegant coffee table set is the perfect combination of modern design and practical functionality. The set consists of two square tables of different sizes: the large table measures 60*60*45 cm and the small table 45*45*40 cm. The table tops of both tables are coated with a high-gloss marble pattern that adds a touch of luxury and sophistication to any room. Thanks to their sturdy construction, both tables can support up to 30 kg, making them reliable furniture for everyday use. A special feature of this set are the height-adjustable feet on the underside of the tables. This means that the tables adapt perfectly to uneven floors and remain stable at all times. The set is versatile and can be combined into a harmonious placemat or set up separately in different rooms, depending on your needs. The simple but elegant design blends perfectly with different interior styles, be it modern, classic or minimalist. This coffee table set not only offers stylish storage options, but is also a practical solution for any living space. With its high-quality workmanship and timeless design, it is ideal for those looking for practical and aesthetic furniture.
